name: gemini-web-worker
description: Delegate bounded tasks to Gemini in a browser, then review and continue in Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Codex 派單，Gemini 網頁處理，Codex 驗收。
interface.longDescription: A skill-based workflow using an existing browser-control tool. Codex prepares task packets, reads Gemini replies, verifies results and requests bounded revisions. Requires a connected browser and Gemini access; no Gemini API integration is bundled.
defaultPrompt: 用 Gemini 網頁版處理一個可以獨立驗收嘅子任務，再由你檢查結果繼續做。
請 Gemini 網頁版提出方案，由你驗證同整合。
